method.gridded: Open-Meteo archive, model best_match, at each station's 0.1-degree cell
method.correction: leave-one-station-out: each station corrected only from the other stations' 12x24 tables (IDW, 150 km, closed-station rule)
method.why: Correcting every metric made chill worse (see mae_if_every_metric_corrected); GDD error roughly halves. So the app corrects heat only and chill uses the raw gridded temperatures.

own_table_held_out.about: Durham corrected with its own table fit on its other seasons: the live app's setup near Durham.

nearest_station_baseline.about: Biggs #244 CIMIS readings (25 km away) used as Durham's: a grower's alternative when Durham closed.
